Hi Jane — thanks for the clear note. I pulled together a short outline below and attached a one-page initial_pricing_outline.pdf for your procurement team. High level:

1) Licensing: Annual subscription by deployment unit (per reserved GPU pool). We publish reference SKUs but final sizing is based on required throughput/latency.

2) Platform fee: Annual platform fee (covers control plane, monitoring, upgrades). Standard practice is a flat annual fee; we have discount levers for multi-year commits.

3) Support tiers:
- Standard: business hours support, 48hr SLA for sev1
- Premier: 24x7 support, 4hr SLA for sev1, named TAM, quarterly reviews and onboarding assistance

4) Typical concessions: onboarding credits, reduced platform fee in year 1 for annual commit, and volume discounts on reserved capacity.

Quick ask: could you share the expected committed spend range (annual) and whether you need an on-prem install or VPC (cloud)? That will help me pull pricing bands and an example term sheet.

I can be available tomorrow afternoon for a 20–30m call.

Best,
Ben Carter
